Contact Us

We are happy to hear your feedback, suggestions and corrections about the website and the app.

We are here to help

At Mizan we welcome all your messages, whether it is a question about how one of the tools works on the website or in the smartphone app (Android and iOS), a report of an error in a calculation result, a note about how the Mushaf, tafsirs and adhkar are displayed or about the translations in the 15 languages, or a suggestion for a new feature. Your feedback is what helps us develop Mizan and increase its accuracy and quality.

Email

You can write to us directly at: mizanalmuslimhilal@gmail.com

Or use the form below, and the email program on your device will open with a ready-made message containing what you wrote, for you to send yourself. The form does not send any data to our servers.

Tips for a clearer message

  • When reporting an error in a calculator: mention the name of the tool, the inputs you used, the result that appeared, and the expected result with its source if possible.
  • When reporting an issue in the mobile app: mention your device type (Android or iOS), the selected display language, and the screen where the problem appeared.
  • When correcting religious content or a translation: include the surah and verse number, or the dhikr section, and the evidence or fiqh reference you are relying on.
  • For prayer times: mention your city, the selected calculation method and the local timetable you are comparing with.

Response time

We aim to reply to all messages within three to five working days. Reports that require religious review or a software update may take longer, and we will let you know when the error is corrected, in sha' Allah.

Important notice: Mizan is a platform of Islamic tools and references, and we do not issue fatwas on personal matters. If you have a specific question about inheritance, zakat or anything else, please refer to a trusted scholar, the fatwa authority or the competent Sharia court in your country.
